source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The SDK initializes SentryUnitySdk from the options configured in the editor window, installs integrations (log capture) and a Unity HTTP transport. Android, iOS and native modules add per-platform crash capture, and the iOS build post-processing prepares the Xcode project.
